spec.name: sprint25_taker_imbalance_momentum_majors_v1
spec.hypothesis: Taker imbalance predicts short-horizon continuation, not reversion, in majors — motivated by sprint22's reversion result (mean_net=-11.13bps, t=-9.35, n=475), whose sign implies the opposite-direction trade may carry the edge.
spec.power_argument: Inherit sprint22's exact sample construction (n=475 over the same window) which already demonstrated t=-9.35 for the fade; a same-magnitude effect in the flipped direction clears the >=300 trade / min-detectable-edge bar without new data collection.
spec.params: inherit sprint22 registry entry verbatim (window, threshold) — only entry direction flipped from fade to follow
